definition: Whether the producing software normalizes the value across runs; which method a run used is not catalogued.
How the value combines the signals of lower-level features, such as precursors into a protein group; none for a value measured on the feature's own signal.
The MS level the value is measured on: the precursor's MS1 signal, or its MS2 fragments' signals.
Time unit or scale of the retained numeric value, before any consumer conversion. Unknown means the source does not establish one unit for this field.
